summary: Mark visible thread replies read and update the existing Inbox hint

replay.detail: Acknowledgements use the existing replicated message.read facts.

schema.detail: The client contract adds thread.read, an exact thread summary selector, and an optional Inbox thread hint on negotiated attention subscriptions.

rules.detail: Only the owning person with the message control grant can acknowledge exact admitted visible replies.

compatibility.detail: Clients negotiate exact summaries and Inbox hints with separate capabilities. The legacy subscription forms keep their established shapes.

downtime.detail: The daemon derives read summaries and hints from the existing store during ordinary serving.

manual.detail: The client exposes an explicit Mark visible replies read action once the daemon grants it.

recovery.detail: Replicated message read facts reconstruct the hint on the next projection.
